name: io.github.paidwithtab/tab
title: tab
description: Agents pay per call over HTTP 402: 8,600+ API routes, owner-signed budgets, signed receipts.

environmentVariables.name: TAB_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Agent key file. Default ~/.tab/agent.json, which `npx paidwithtab init` creates with a mandate and starter credits.

environmentVariables.name: TAB_MAX_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call priced above this many dollars, e.g. 0.05.
